_note: New actor, first pricing entry. Market: apify/google-trends-scraper $0.003 per item with 1,754 monthly users; most others add a $0.02-0.025 start fee. This matches $0.003 per keyword with no start fee; a keyword row carries every data type asked for. Trending Now rows are cheap to produce and priced at $0.001. Keywords with no data are free. No proxy: platform cost was $0.005 for 80 keyword sets in testing.

keyword_result.eventDescription: One keyword with every data type you asked for: interest over time with its summary, interest by region, and top and rising related queries. A keyword Google has no data for is returned free.

trending_search.eventDescription: One Trending Now search for a country, with approximate traffic, start time, picture and news links.
